d: Short, curly honey-blonde hair with thick bangs frames a youthful, cheerful face with wide, bright blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a navy blue sailor-collared top with a black bow, layered under a sleeveless white apron dress featuring silver buttons and a cinched waist. A small white sailor cap with a black ribbon sits atop the head, and the outfit is completed with a grey glove on one hand.
